description: A real Notion API skill for managed-OAuth access to pages, databases, blocks, comments, users, and workspace search via the Notion API.
authorization_notes: Page creation and update write content to the Notion workspace; confirm the parent page, title, and property values before creating or updating.
Block appending modifies the structure of existing pages; confirm the block content and location before appending.
Database query filters may expose sensitive data; verify the filter criteria and intended use before executing.
Comment creation adds visible discussion context to pages; confirm comment content before posting.
Page deletion permanently removes content; confirm the page identity before deleting.
